purpose: Focused pre-recruitment validation of the M4 asymmetry contrast d_asym at the locked H1 N=84 design.

estimator.primary_prediction: couple-clustered participant RMSE difference on days 12-14 with t-based confidence intervals across couples
estimator.note: Random intercept and slope heterogeneity is generated but is not parameterized as a required random-effects distribution in the primary GEE.

missingness.note: missingness_strength=0 gives non-informative prompt nonresponse conditional on person response propensity; 1 applies the full state/action-dependent mechanism.

notes: This focused validation is independent of the completed 120,000-replication H1 exact-design grid.
It was used only to calibrate the M4 asymmetry contrast. Its N=84 setting is historical and does not determine the final sample size after the later comparable-lag correction.
M3 truth implies d_asym = 0 under the fitted M4 parameterization; M4 truth in this design implies d_asym = 2.0 + (-1.2) = 0.8.
Only compliance levels at or above the locked planning floor are evaluated.
The asymmetry tolerance is not chosen automatically from simulation performance.

execution.note: Windows FULL preserves deterministic 10-replication chunk identities for resumability, but computes every replication in a fresh Python process. Automatic concurrency is capped at four workers and at most 25% of logical CPUs, with a conservative free-memory guard. Each isolated replication has bounded retries; strict merge rejects overlapping or missing replication keys. Worker processes suppress modal Windows crash dialogs.

ipw_sensitivity.status: prespecified sensitivity; final truncation choice pending targeted Monte Carlo
ipw_sensitivity.assumption: history-based MAR conditional on the denominator response model; not a correction guarantee for contemporaneous unobserved-state MNAR
diagnostics: maximum stabilized lag weight after truncation
weighted versus primary holdout RMSE difference
ipw_sensitivity.covariance_note: statsmodels 0.15.0 observation weights are incompatible with its bias-reduced covariance path in the pinned implementation; weighted finite-cluster coverage is therefore evaluated explicitly in targeted Monte Carlo

final_design.multiplicity: Holm family-wise alpha 0.05 across the two co-primary one-sided SESOI tests
final_design.rmse_role: secondary predictive evidence; no sequential gating
final_design.asymmetry_tolerance_status: FINAL BEFORE DATA; this focused simulation evaluates prespecified candidates
final_design.analysis_target_couples_status: historical N=84 setting for asymmetry validation only; final H1 N pending comparable-lag recalibration

classification.asymmetry_material: 90% CI wholly outside the equivalence region on one side

asymmetry_validation.selection_rule: Guardrails may reject unsuitable candidate tolerances but do not automatically choose a scientific tolerance. Final locking additionally requires substantive action-scale calibration before recruitment.
